input: Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text, /moves/bishop_c8.text, /moves/knight_g8.text or /moves/pawn_a7.text (the agents who have already gone off plan through amnesia or greed) must be signed by at least fourteen distinct Black agents in addition to that piece's own key, and every commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text must also modify /turn/ply.num.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_a7.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false))
